entries.en: Available in all economies.  Produced and accepted by town buildings, and also a few industries.
Available in all economies.  Produced and accepted by town buildings.
Basic iron from a blast furnace, as molten liquid or solid ingots.
Biomass from peat bogs, extracted for fuel and horticulture.
By-product from coke production, a thick slow-flowing liquid.
CIRS includes a set of landscaping objects, which players can place to make certain industries appear larger. Landscape object have no gameplay effect. Landscaping objects can be turned on or off.
Cabs, bonnets, doors and similar body structures for vehicle production.
Calcium Oxide, also known as burnt lime. Transported as fine powder that must be kept dry.
Cast products such as blocks, beams and panels. Can also be handled as ready-mix concrete in mixer trucks.
Cement, glass, metal components, wood products, pipes and similar construction materials.
Chemicals, soaps, scouring agents etc for industrial and domestic use. Primarily liquid, can also be powder or solid (such as shot blasting sand).
Civil explosives for mining, construction etc.
Coal that has been heated in a coke oven, producing a fuel that is nearly pure carbon.
Coarse sand for construction, or fine silica sand for glass-making and metal casting. Transported as bulk or powder.
Common beans, fava beans, soybeans and similar edible legumes.
Complex economy featuring iron, steel and heavy manufacturing industries.
Complex economy with many industries and cargos.
Complex economy with many industries and cargos. Inspired by central-western Africa. Best used with Sub-Tropic climate.
Components for vehicle production such as chassis and suspension components, electrical parts, external trim and interior parts.
Cotton, flax, jute and similar materials, for producing textiles and composite materials.
Crude, unrefined petroleum transported as bulk liquid.
Drums, winches, shackles, hooks, pulleys, hydraulic rams and other parts for cranes, hoists, elevators etc.
Dry cement in powder or clinker form.
Edible root crop, also known as manioc and yuca.
Electrical and electronic components, motors, controllers, switchgear, lights etc.
Fine wire used to reinforce tyres. Transported as coil.
Flexible seals, gaskets, hoses, belts, mats, bushings, etc, made from rubber or similar materials.
Foods kept frozen during transport and storage.
For household and construction use. Tools, utensils, fixtures, fittings, in metal and other materials.
Fresh and dried fruit, such as bananas, citrus, grapes, berries, pineapple, raisins and similar.
Generic clays, for producing building materials and other industrial uses.
Generic metal, such as steel, aluminium or other common metals.
Generic organic and inorganic chemicals, handled as liquid, gas, covered bulk, powder, or as piece goods.
Gravel, sand, crushed stone and similar materials used in construction.
High-value engineering components such as electrical equipment, motors, transformers, control gear, hydraulics, pneumatics, pumps, valves and powertrain equipment.
Industrial acid used mainly in fertiliser and chemical production, transported as bulk liquid.
Industrial acids, such as hydrochloric, nitric and sulphuric acid.
Industrial alcohol used as a chemical feedstock and fuel, transported as bulk liquid.
Industrial chemical, usually transported cryogenically as liquified compressed gas.
Industrial chemical. Also known as Lye or Caustic Soda. Usually transported as liquid.
Industrial chemicals derived from ammonia, such as ammonia, nitric acid and urea. Transported as liquids, cryogenically as liquified gas, or as dry bulk.
Industrial chemicals used in manufacturing and processing, transported as liquids, powders, gases or packaged goods.
Industrial gas. Transported cryogenically as liquified compressed gas.
Industrial gases used in chemical processing, metalworking and welding, transported in cylinders or pressure tankers.
Industrial mineral, also known as Kaolin, used primarily in paper and plastics production.
Industrial minerals used in chemical processing. Barytes is used in barium chemicals and fillers; fluorspar in fluorine chemistry and metallurgical fluxes.
Ingredients used in food processing, such as preservatives, flavourings, colourings and processing aids.
Intensely black carbon powder, used in tyres, plastics and pigments.  Handled as a powder.
Intermediate chemical products used as feedstocks for further industrial processing.
Intermediate sugar products for refining, fermentation and industrial uses. Sticky granules are handled as covered bulk; thick syrup as liquid; either may be packaged.
Internal combustion engines and related powertrain parts such as transmission and drive axles.
Light petroleum fractions used as chemical feedstocks, transported as bulk liquids.
Long hollow tube in round, rectangular and other cross-sections. Used for fabricating structures and machinery.
Long round steel pipes for transporting liquids in pipelines, buildings, industries etc.
Machinery, fuel, parts, fertiliser and other supplies for farms, forests and similar industries.
Machinery, fuel, parts, wood products, pipes, explosives and other supplies for mines and similar industries.
Machinery, parts, fuel, construction materials and other supplies for harbours, docks and similar industries.
Manganese ore, used primarily in steel production.
Metal parts for assembly into larger items.
Mostly cows, pigs and sheep for meat production.  Other animals may also be eaten.
Mostly trucks. Or cars. Or light trucks. Maybe tractors.
Non-ferrous metals, such as copper, nickel, zinc and lead.
Powdered cereal products such as flour and starch, transported bagged or in covered bulk.
Powered equipment and mechanical systems used in buildings, industries and farms. Transported as complete units or as major subassemblies.
Processed wood fibre used mainly for paper production, transported as bales or bulk pulp.
Processed wood products from a sawmill or similar industries.
Raw plastic for futher processing. Usually transported as resin beads.
Refined Aluminium metal, in coils, ingots, slabs etc.
Refined Copper metal, in coils, ingots etc.
Refined petroleum products such as petrol, diesel, kerosene, LPG, fuel oil and bunker fuel, transported as bulk liquids or liquefied gas.
Rolled steel plates and sections - I beams, H beams, channels etc. Transported as long straight products.
Ropes and cables produced by drawing steel wire rod to a smaller diameter, then twisting into bundled ropes.
Rough steel castings, requiring further processing. Ingots may be small or very large. Typical ingot profiles are rectangular or round.
Semi-finished steel castings. Always flat and rectangular in cross-section.
Semi-finished steel castings. Rectangular, square or round in cross-section.
Simple economy. Inspired by Argentina, Peru and Chile. Best used with Sub-Tropic climate.
Simple economy. Inspired by Finland, Northern Canada and Northern Siberia. Best used with Sub-Arctic climate.
Simple economy. Inspired by south-western UK. Best used with Temperate climate.
Speciality carbon materials such as calcined petroleum coke, pitch, high-value tars and carbon black, used in metallurgical and chemical processes.
Steel bars, as rounds, squares, flats and other profiles. Transported as long straight products.
Steel wire and thin rods. Primarily transported as coils.
Storage tanks, pressure vessels, silos, gas cylinders, and pipe assemblies, for use in town buildings, industries and farms.
Structural-grade steel as rolled sections (I beams, H beams etc), or as flat plate, or as fabricated sections and beams welded from plate.
Sulfide minerals, smelted to produce a variety of industrial products.
Supplies for cutting and welding metal, such as welding rods, tools, and industrial gases including acetylene, argon, propane, oxygen and nitrogen.
Thick petroleum product used mainly for road surfacing and roofing.
Thin rolled steel sheet and strip, widely used to fabricate other products. Transported as flat sheets or as coils.
Thin rough steel bars widely used to reinforce concrete structures. Transported as coils or bundles of straight bars.
Thin steel sheet coated with tin for corrosion resistance, used mainly for cans, containers and other packaging.
Used in alloy and stainless steel production, an alloy of chromium and iron.  Grey lumps, similar in size and shape to coal lumps.
Used in steel production. Alloys of iron and other elements including manganese, nickel, chromium, aluminium, silicon and tungsten.  Grey lumps, similar in size and shape to coal lumps.
Waste product from iron and steel production.
White powder refined from bauxite ore, used to produce aluminium metal.
White, grey or brown calcium sulphate rock, used in sulphuric acid and cement production. Often transported as covered bulk.
Widely used industrial chemical. Bright yellow, in powder or liquid form.
Widely used industrial chemical. Usually transported as bulk cargo that must be kept dry.
